description: Typed configuration for an Oxide project (spec §14).

adapter.description: §18: the deploy target the build emits for; the §18 capability matrix decides what that target honours (the config-key refusal refuses a build the target cannot serve).

brownout.description: V2-F12: brownout mode. Under overload the governor degrades deliberately - stale content past the SWR window behind warning 110, low-priority routes shed with 503 + x-oxide-brownout, readiness flips to 503 at Emergency. Off by default - with enabled false no governor is constructed. Validation (DSP-113): ascending threshold ladders, a staleCeiling multiplier >= 1, hedge.afterFactor > 1.

enabled.description: Master switch; false keeps the request path at its pre-F12 shape.

hedge.description: The opt-in hedger: duplicate a still-running idempotent GET render after afterFactor x the route's recent p95; first response wins. Idempotency is the user's responsibility.

afterFactor.description: Hedge after this multiple of the recent p95 (DSP-113 rejects <= 1).

staleCeiling.description: How far past the TTL an L0 entry may serve at level Stale, as a multiplier: '10x', plain '10', or fractional '1.5x' (DSP-113 rejects < 1).

thresholds.description: The three breach ladders; rung i is the level-(i+1) threshold, a signal at or above it breaches that level. Ladders must be ascending (DSP-113).

loopLagMs.description: Event-loop lag rungs in ms (spec defaults).

queueWaitMs.description: Pool queue-wait p99 rungs in ms (spec defaults).

rssMb.description: Resident-memory rungs in MiB; 0 disables the RSS gate (the spec default is never).

clientJs.description: §21: the per-entry client JS budget (e.g. `170kb`); `oxide analyze` fails when the bundle exceeds it.

edgeExternals.description: §18 / D18: specifiers left external in the edge bundle. Empty by default — the Worker must be self-contained unless it declares a node-compat layer.

remoteCache.description: §5.4: remote build-cache URL (http://). Read-through on a local miss, write-back on store.

routeSearch.description: §16.5: emit the route-search index (dist/client/search-index.json). On by default when prerendered pages exist; set false for projects that do not ship a client-side search UI.

sourcemap.description: §6: the sourcemap mode the client bundle emits (`hidden` ships the map without linking it).

ssrExternals.description: §6: packages kept external in the SSR bundle and required at runtime (the CLI fills a framework default when unset).

target.description: §6: the browser target the client bundle compiles for (e.g. `baseline-widely-available`).

writeBranches.description: §5.4 / SPEC-5D: git branches trusted to write the shared remote cache. Default main/master + release/* when remoteCache is set.

type.description: §5.3: the L2 cache-handler backend the build wires (memory/disk are local; redis/s3/http are remote).

maxSize.description: §5.3: the L0 in-process cache budget (`kb`/`mb`/`gb`); over-cap entries are GC'd (SPEC-5D).

ttlSecs.description: P-05: L0 freshness window in seconds (default 300).

vary.description: Request headers the L0 fingerprint varies on. The primary language tag of accept-language is normalized automatically.

dir.description: §16.5: the content directory (Markdown + typed frontmatter) the collection maps to.

indexedFields.description: §16.5: the frontmatter fields the per-collection static JSON index includes.

name.description: §16.5: the collection name (also the static JSON index file's stem).

dev.description: §13.5: dev-server options (https, host, qr, open, proxy).

experiments.description: V2-F04 / §15.4: A/B experiments evaluated natively per request before the L0 lookup, so an experiment is a cache-key dimension (the |exp: vary suffix) instead of forcing the route dynamic. Validation (DSP-110): traffic is a 0-100 percentage and each experiment needs at least two variants. Off by default - with no experiments configured every L0 key stays byte-identical to the pre-F04 baseline.

id.description: The experiment id - also the locals key and the vary-suffix name.

routes.description: URL-pattern prefixes the experiment applies to; empty = all routes.

sticky.description: V2-F04: how an eligible identity sticks to its variant — a cookie, a request header, or a hash of the peer IP.

cookieName.description: The cookie storage key, e.g. oxide_hero.

headerName.description: The request header storage key, e.g. x-bucket.

traffic.description: Percentage of eligible identities in the experiment (DSP-110).

variants.description: Variant names, in config order (DSP-110: at least two).

extends.description: §14.2: shared configs to merge before this file.

family.description: §16.2: the CSS family name the emitted @font-face declares.

localPaths.description: §16.2: local font files used instead of a provider download.

provider.description: §16.2: the provider this family downloads from (one of `fonts.providers`).

providers.description: §16.2: the font providers families may reference.

subset.description: §16.2 / C08: the subsetting strategy — `latin`, `unicode-range`, or the glyph-usage spelling `used` (sound only when every route is `static`; otherwise the build refuses with AST-FNT-001).

adapter.description: §7: the component dialect the adapter compiles (the loader in `page.server.ts` stays framework-neutral).

compiler.description: C01: the native compiler pass for the adapter. true prefers the native backend when its toolchain is healthy; the node backend is the fallback (C01 / `compilerBackend`).

islands.description: §10.3 islands registry: component name → source file. The CLI emits a synthetic __boot__ client entry that imports each entry; `<Island chunk="X">` on a page resolves to X in this map.

name.description: §7: the framework adapter package the config exports (`@oxide-fw/react`, `@oxide-fw/vue`, ...).

default.description: §11: the default locale — no path prefix under `prefix-except-default`.

locales.description: §11: the locales the site serves (the route prefix follows `strategy`).

strategy.description: Locale routing strategy: `prefix` (always), `prefix-except-default` (omit the default locale), `none` (no path prefix; cookie/Accept-Language only).

formats.description: §16.1: the encodings `/_oxide/image` emits, in preference order (avif via ravif).

maxConcurrency.description: §16.1: maximum concurrent rasterizations. Each transform is CPU-bound; unbounded concurrency lets a few clients saturate every core.

maxDimension.description: §16.1: largest accepted `w`/`h`. A user-supplied size is not trusted to allocate an arbitrarily large canvas.

remotePatterns.description: §16.1: the remote image hosts the endpoint may fetch; a host not listed is refused.

host.description: §16.1: a remote host the image endpoint may fetch from (the SSRF allow-list for remote images).

imagesEndpoint.description: S-09: on-demand image transform endpoint (GET /_oxide/image). On by default; gateable.

interactionReplay.description: V2-F03: the pre-hydration interaction replay opt-out. Default true (flag absent = enabled): the boot capture records interactions until each island hydrates and replays them on done. false advertises interactionReplay:false in window.__oxide so boot skips startReplay. A non-boolean value fails the load (DSP-114).

live.description: V2-F05: live-loader transport knobs (the SSE hub's capacity, cadence and transport). Defaults are inert - with no route opting in (page.server.ts live: true) nothing listens and no hub is constructed. Validation (DSP-111): keepaliveSeconds >= 1, maxSubscribers >= 1, maxRerunsPerSecond >= 1, perIpMax <= maxSubscribers.

keepaliveSeconds.description: SSE keepalive ping period in seconds (DSP-111 rejects 0).

maxRerunsPerSecond.description: Per-subscriber rerun rate cap per second.

maxSubscribers.description: The hub's total subscriber capacity; the endpoint answers 503 + retry-after above it.

perIpMax.description: Per-peer subscriber cap (security); cannot exceed maxSubscribers.

transport.description: sse streams snapshots over GET /__oxide/live; poll is the serverless fallback.

manifest.description: §16.3: web app manifest (PWA). Present -> oxide build emits manifest.webmanifest + a service worker.

og.description: S-09: on-demand OG-image endpoint (GET /_oxide/og). Off by default; opt in with og.enabled = true.

enabled.description: S-09: opt in to the OG-image endpoint (`GET /_oxide/og`; off by default).

rateLimit.description: A3: per-peer token-bucket limit applied before rasterization.

max.description: A3: the images per window per peer before the bucket refills.

windowSecs.description: A3: the rate-limit window length in seconds.

default.description: §10.1: the render mode routes inherit when `page.server.ts` exports none (`auto` infers per route).

ppr.description: §10.8 partial prerendering: serve the cached static shell instantly and stream holes live

dir.description: §10.1: the route directory the scanner walks (file conventions decide the route tree).

destination.description: §10.4: the rewrite destination (evaluated natively before the route match).

priority.description: V2-F12: the route's overload priority; low-priority routes shed at brownout level Shed, everything but critical at Emergency (DSP-113 rejects other spellings).

source.description: §10.4: the path pattern the native rule matches.

search.description: V2-F09: the built-in search surface. Inert by default - with no collections configured nothing indexes and the §18 config-key refusal reports the surface as unconfigured. A non-empty collections list is the 'search configured' fact the refusal consults (AST-SRC-001 on a target without the Search capability); the F09 engine consumes the query knobs from this same key.

collections.description: The content collections (§16.5 names) the built-in search indexes. Empty = search not configured; a non-empty list is the §18 refusal's 'search configured' surface.

fields.description: Query-time field boosts (F09 defaults: title 3, body 1).

title.description: The title-field boost; title matches outrank body matches.

cookieKeys.description: SEC-05 / §16.6: cookie-signing keys (32+ bytes each, first signs). Empty = derive from `.oxide/secret`.

exposeCacheHeader.description: S-21.3: emit the `x-oxide-fw-cache` status header. Default true.

hostAllowList.description: §S-20: the hosts the server answers for; a request with another Host is a 421 misdirected request.

sessionKeys.description: ≥32-byte base64 keys for the ChaCha20-Poly1305 session codec; first seals, all decrypt (rotation).

ssrfAllowList.description: §S-20: the hosts server-side fetches (image endpoint, loaders) may reach.

trustedProxies.description: SEC-05 / S-10: the CIDRs whose `X-Forwarded-For` is trusted for the client IP (rate-limit keying); empty trusts no proxy.

backend.description: §12: the SSR backend — `node` (the supervised Node ≥ 24 worker pool, the production default) or `v8` (embedded V8, opt-in).

compression.description: §12.1 step 8: the precompressed static encodings in preference order (zstd preferred, then br, then gzip; negotiated per request).

h3Advertise.description: §12.1 / C3: emit the `Alt-Svc: h3` header on the TLS listener. Default true when http3 is enabled; set false to keep the QUIC listener silent while browsers are not ready for it.

host.description: §12: the bind address of the production server.

http3.description: §12.1: serve HTTP/3 over QUIC alongside h1/h2 (opt-in; `h3Advertise` controls the Alt-Svc header).

port.description: §12: the TCP port the production server binds (h1/h2; the QUIC listener follows §12.1).

siteUrl.description: §16.3: absolute site origin used by sitemap.xml and robots.txt.

fallback.description: Path to a fallback HTML file emitted for dynamic routes without prerendered output (§10.5).

stream.description: V2-F07: resumable-stream bounds. A streamed response marked x-oxide-stream stays replayable for the ttl at GET /__oxide/stream/<id> with Range: bytes=<n>-. Defaults are inert - the store only exists while a resumable response is being teed. Size literals use the section-14 grammar (b|kb|mb|gb|tb, plain digits are bytes). Validation (DSP-112): ttlSecs >= 1, maxBytesEach >= 1 byte, maxBytesTotal >= maxBytesEach; a bad literal fails with CFG-SIZE.

maxBytesEach.description: Per-stream replay cap; past it the buffer loses replay and the client falls back to a fresh fetch.

maxBytesTotal.description: Store-wide cap; the accounting evicts the oldest completed buffer first, then the oldest buffer.

ttlSecs.description: How long a buffer stays reattachable, in seconds (DSP-112 rejects 0).

sw.description: §16.6: service worker configuration. Present only when the project wants to control emission beyond the default (manifest presence).

enabled.description: §16.6: emit the service worker at build. Default true when `manifest` is present; an explicit `false` disables emission even with a manifest.

offlineFallback.description: §16.6: the offline-fallback route the worker serves for a navigation miss. Default `/offline` when the build produced that route; otherwise `/`.

title: Oxide config
